name: Promo
description: A short video that gets the viewer to do one thing: follow, visit, buy or come along. Pick it to promote a page, a product or an event.

structure.purpose: Show the problem or the wish the viewer already has.
Show what answers it, in use, with one clear benefit.
One reason to believe it: a number, a name or a result.
Say the one thing to do next, and show it on screen.

hookRules: The first 3 seconds show the viewer's own problem or wish. No greeting and no logo intro.

rules: Everything said about a product, a price, an offer or a date comes from what Biku supplies. Nothing is invented.
